name: Ups and Downs With 3 levels! - Platformer, Shooting and Dodge!!
author: prabalcode
description: This is A LEGO game but not the microgame, It has 3 new levels added into it which are:- Level 1 - Platformer, Level 2 - Shooter, Level 3 - Dodge. In Level 1 to climb a mountain press "W" or "Up Key" while pressing space bar twice which means go forward while doing a flip! Hope you Like my Game!!!
